Not so sure about all of them, but I can confirm the crash on videos starting, as well as the chance for the wrong videos to play.

details:
Hi there,

im the developer of the map "Karaoke World" (wrld_01a6cba6-c525-4b77-a7df-2a44a7f17c12) and have some problems with the VRC_SyncVideoStream component i cannot fix by myself. i would like to make a small list of my problems so maybe you could assist me how to fix them. i used the discord server a lot times to find people with semilar problems, but seems like im the only one who uses the syncvideostream component instead the syncvideoplayer component so i dont have anyone to ask for help at the moment.


Unlike other karaoke maps, i dont download every song at the beginning because its not nessesary at all. my map uses a playlist system to download the song that is played on demand, so songs are added to the playlist and downloaded. but there are some random problems with that:


1. while syncvideoplayer is using the unity videoplayer, the syncvideostream component is using the AVProVideo asset which causes some problems on Windows 7 systems (not supported by the asset). Players with Windows 7 using the DirectShow engine instead the MF framework which was available since windows 8, so they can see the video but wont hear any sounds from it.


2. late joiners have to download every song that was played before (+lots of youtubedl traffic, i dont know what its loading or why), even if the song is not on the playlist anymore. the map contains a clear button to empty the playlist and all the triggers are set to unbuffered but the game generates still a lot of traffic of you join a public session that was already running for a few minutes. i cannot figure out why they still downloading stuff that is dont nessesary anymore. usually there are not more than 10 songs at the same time on the playlist. maybe i need to figure out a way to clean that playlist buffer somehow that shouldnt happen anyway because the unbuffered setting. if the map is on for about an hour i noticed that late joiners have to wait about 10 minutes to load the songs and then crash instandly when its finished. (not happen on new instances). as pointed this kind of problem only happens on instances which are already running for a few minutes, new instances are not affected. is there any way to clear the buffer of the syncvideostream component manually so i can assign it to the clear button?


3. sometimes players get different videos randomly after skip (like one player plays song 1 while all the other players see song 2 at the same time) that is absolutly not supposed to happen, i noticed it sometimes by myself. it doesnt matter if the syncvideostream component was set to karaoke or normal mode, the actual played video got out of sync. this will be fixed after the next video on the playlist is played, but i cant find a workaround for this because i dont know why it happens. at first a thought about it might be because old or slow computers, but i got a highend pc with fast internet connection and also experience the problem sometimes.


4. there are some players that crash immediately after a video starts to play for them (always the same players). they can freely move on the map and doing all the stuff they want, but as soon the first video starts they crash. i requested some logfiles from them, but there is no entry between video play and crash. i know its because the syncvideostream, but since the log file is empty at the time of the crash i cannot see whats happen. (at first i thought its because of windows 7, but windows 10 users also have that crash problem) 

5. if for some reason the video is not done yet, the console keeps spammed with Play and RemoteSet commands, no matter if the setting was set to karaoke or normal. everytime i notice that kind of bug (that affects late joiners) i can see a huge traffic on youtube-dl in task manager, even if its supposed just to load one single video.
title: VRC_SyncVideoStream causes massive traffic
